name: ragbase-shield
description: Local pseudonymisation for client files. Claude reads your documents masked (PERSONNE_A, SOCIETE_B, IBAN_1); the table of codes and real names stays on your computer.
long_description:
**RAGbase Shield** pseudonymises client data on your own computer before Claude sees it, and restores the real names on the same computer afterwards. Nothing is sent to RAGbase. No telemetry, no network calls.

How it works:

1. Register a dossier folder once with Shield Desk or the command line (`ragbase-shield add <folder>`).
2. In Claude, ask for work on the dossier. Claude lists the documents and reads them **masked** through the Shield tools. It sees codes such as PERSONNE_A or SOCIETE_B for the names Shield detects or you register.
3. Claude saves the final draft with `shield_save_draft`. Shield restores the real names locally and writes the file into the `Shield - sorties` folder of the dossier.

Important: connect a folder, do not attach the file to the chat, and do not paste raw client text into the chat. Attached or pasted content reaches the provider before Shield can act.

This is pseudonymisation (reversible), not anonymisation. Detection is never complete: review the masked text for sensitive cases.

---

**RAGbase Shield** pseudonymise les données clients sur votre ordinateur avant que Claude ne les voie, puis restaure les vrais noms sur ce même ordinateur. Rien n'est envoyé à RAGbase. Aucune télémétrie, aucun appel réseau.

Connectez un dossier, ne joignez pas le fichier au chat, et ne collez pas de texte client brut dans le chat. Il s'agit d'une pseudonymisation locale et réversible, pas d'une anonymisation.

tools.name: shield_list_dossiers
tools.description: List the registered dossiers by code (DOSSIER_1, DOSSIER_2...) with document and entity counts. Never shows real dossier titles.

tools.name: shield_list_documents
tools.description: List the documents of a dossier by coded id (DOC_n) with masked file names, type and size.

tools.name: shield_read_document
tools.description: Read one document of a dossier, masked on this computer. Returns text with codes (PERSONNE_A, SOCIETE_B, IBAN_1) instead of real values. Supports paging.

tools.name: shield_search
tools.description: Search the documents of a dossier locally. Returns masked snippets only.

tools.name: shield_save_draft
tools.description: Save the final draft (written with codes) into the dossier's 'Shield - sorties' folder. Real names are restored on this computer only; the tool returns a coded file id and the size, never the restored text.

tools.name: shield_status
tools.description: Show the Shield version, the detection mode and its honest limits.
